name: media_probe
description: Inspect a video or audio file with FFprobe: container, duration, size, overall bitrate, and every stream (codec, resolution, frame rate, pixel format, rotation, sample rate, channels, language), plus chapters. Use it before editing to learn a file's length and format, or to answer questions about a media file. format "json" returns the full FFprobe data.

input.description: Path of the video or audio file, relative to the workspace.

format.description: summary (readable, default) or json (complete FFprobe output).
